svg.title: One cluster across two playgrounds
svg.desc: Three controllers and five workers. Node traffic uses Tailscale.

g.text: Three controllers and five workers. Node traffic uses Tailscale.
WireGuard encrypts node, API, etcd, and VXLAN traffic.
Workers select a healthy controller through a local API proxy.
Controllers run no workload Pods. etcd uses ports 2379 and 2380. No external API VIP.
Cilium runs on all five workers.
No kube-proxy. Internet egress leaves through eth0. Cilium owns Pod and Service routing.
Tailscale authenticates the caller; Kubernetes RBAC authorizes the operation.
The tailscale-k0s context connects directly to a controller on port 6443.
It uses an admin client certificate and does not depend on the in-cluster proxy.
